current.title: Block Adventure & Console Launch Prep
current.note: As of compile date 2026-08-19 this is the live version; a 3.0.3 bug-fix pass landed Aug 18, and a Shop-adjustments dev blog + Fair Play ban report (232 accounts, Aug 7-13) were also posted Aug 19. Check the official news page (linked in the Sources section) for anything newer.

highlights: Limited-time 'Block Adventure' event on Wish Island (Aug 5-23): fight blocky creatures, challenge the Block Wanderer boss, earn morphed Deviations (Zapamander, Nutcracker & Dr. Teddy variants).
Online Trading overhaul: purchase-order buying requests, reduced bind times, watchlist expanded to 20 items, trading extended to ingots, formulas, cosmetic fish and animals.
New Permanent Server Monthly Challenges with mod-acquisition rewards via Scenario Honor (30-day reset).
Console launch support announced for Aug 25 with cross-platform account linking (PC/mobile/console).
Custom Server territory settings now customizable per user role.
Lightforge Loot Crate 'Dreamtide' (mythic skins, legendary cosmetics); Block World crossover and Midsummer Fizz shop items.
First-person mode optimizations, fishing mechanic clarifications, tech interface improvements, misc. bug fixes.
Territory Construction: flexible snap-point switching for walls, ceilings, roofs, stairs and pillars.
Account-wide appearance preset sharing across characters/scenarios (12-preset limit per gender).
New Item Lock system to prevent accidental discard/trade/disassembly of valuable items.
RaidZone: Mental Pollution — new zones drain mentality over time, offset by gear's Mental Resistance stat; 4 new survival suits trade defense for mental resistance.
RaidZone farming & breeding enhancements: rare plant harvesting, preferred food rewards for livestock.
Custom Server overhaul: server recommendations, exclusive gameplay tags, custom dungeon settings, benefit event (Jul 23-Aug 20).
Lightforge Loot Crate summer return (5 themes); new furniture/facility skin packs (Jul 29).

Balance: ZapCam duration/range up, cooldown up; Mini Wonder duration down, cooldown up; Pyro Dino fire suppression heavily nerfed; SN700-Finale reverb stacks reduced to 4 with adjusted damage scaling.

Visional Wheel S4: Gravity Abyss — zero-gravity combat across floating islands; new Riftwalker aerial boss; Gravity Imbalance exploration, Riftwalker Relic collection, Aerial Hunt, Gravity Integrator challenge modes.
New Wishlist system for shop items with privacy controls; enhanced gifting with friend sorting, personal messages, duplicate-prevention refunds.
New rewards: Abyssal Cores (epic/legendary/mythic), Abyssal Essence, 3 new Morphed Deviations, Aero & Downstar mods, armor Shiny Mods.
Balance: AUG-Electron Cloud flexibility changed; Compound Bow-The Burden of Betrayal damage consistency/burst adjusted; Glide Pants stamina consumption changed.
Terrain adjustments west of Chalk Peak required territory relocation for affected players.
Meta Pass monthly cosmetic rotations; Custom Server 'Special Drops' mode; wedding-themed and carnival shop packs.
Weapon Customization system: freely customize weapon stats and mix-and-match dozens of newly designed weapon traits.
